EVOSABRE.BAD_NUMBER: {{field}} must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
EVOSABRE.SERVICE_FAILED: The display service did not start: {{error}}
EVOSABRE.SECTION_DISPLAY_DOC: The second display, on the right of the front panel. It shows the track, its format and the time played, and a clock while the player rests.
EVOSABRE.OLED_ACTIVE_DOC: Off stops the display's program altogether: the display stays dark and the remote's transport keys are not read.
EVOSABRE.TRACK_TIME_DOC: The time played, the track's length and the bar between them, along the bottom of the display. Off leaves the bottom rows free; meters lying under the track then take them and are drawn taller.
EVOSABRE.METERS_DOC: Two meters beside the track show how loud each channel is, on a scale of sixty decibels. The bright part of a meter is the level, the dimmer part reaches to the peak, and a mark holds the highest peak for a moment. The meters read a tap in the player's audio path, which every stream passes through unchanged; it is in that path only while this is on, and after the plugin is first installed it joins it once the player has restarted.
EVOSABRE.METERS_STYLE_DOC: Lying under the track, the left channel above the right: the artist and the album then share one line. Or upright at the left or the right of the track, the left channel first: the track keeps its three lines, each a little shorter.
EVOSABRE.METERS_GAIN_DOC: Decibels added to what the meters show, from -12 to 12. Raise it for music that leaves the meters low, lower it for music that keeps them at the top. It moves the meters only: what is played is not touched.
EVOSABRE.CLOCK_AFTER_DOC: How long the player rests, paused or stopped, before the clock takes the place of the track. 0 keeps the track.
EVOSABRE.CLOCK_SEGMENTS_DOC: The clock's digits are drawn like LED digits. The segments that are not lit can be left dark, or shown faintly behind the lit ones. Very faint and Faint are the two faintest greys the display can show; Dim is the next one up.
EVOSABRE.SLEEP_AFTER_DOC: How long after the last button on the remote, or after playback started, the display dims. What is playing stays readable. 0 never dims.
EVOSABRE.DEEP_SLEEP_AFTER_DOC: How long after the last button, while nothing plays, the display goes dark. A button on the remote or playback starting lights it again. 0 never goes dark.
EVOSABRE.SECTION_REMOTE_DOC: The streamer obeys five keys of the remote: play and pause, next and previous track, and the two seeks (up and down). The volume, the mute, the input and the power keys are read by the DAC board itself, whatever is set here. After the plugin is first installed, the receiver works once the player has been restarted.
EVOSABRE.REMOTE_ACTIVE_DOC: Off leaves the remote to the DAC board alone.
EVOSABRE.CHECK_REMOTE_DOC: Press a key on the remote, then this button: it says whether the receiver is being read and which key arrived last.
EVOSABRE.REMOTE_NONE: No key has arrived since the display started.
EVOSABRE.REMOTE_NOT_RUNNING: The display's program is not running, so the remote is not being read. Switch the display on, or look at the journal: journalctl -u evosabre-panel
EVOSABRE.SECTION_SOUND_DOC: For a DAC that clicks, or loses the first moment of a track, when playback starts or resumes. On a Raspberry Pi 5 the DAC is given its clocks only while something plays; with this on, the audio output is held open and the clocks never stop. Leave it off if you hear no clicks.
EVOSABRE.CLICK_PREVENTION_DOC: A small program takes over the audio output and passes the music through untouched. While nothing plays it sends noise far too quiet to hear, so the DAC stays locked. A change of sample rate still reopens the output.
EVOSABRE.CLICK_STANDALONE: The Audio Keepalive plugin is switched on and already holds the output open. Click prevention is left off.
EVOSABRE.PATH_FAILED: The player's audio path could not be set up: {{error}}
EVOSABRE.PATH_RESTART_MSG: Click prevention and the level meters join the player's audio path when the player starts. Restart the player to bring them in.
EVOSABRE.SECTION_DAC_DOC: In Playback Options: switch I2S DAC on and choose Audiophonics I-Sabre ES9028Q2M, then restart the player when asked. Set DSD Playback Mode to DSD over PCM (DoP). Under Volume Options set Mixer Type to Hardware, Mixer Control Name to Digital and Volume Curve Mode to Linear: the volume on this display is then the number on the DAC's own display. The DAC board switches the power itself: wait for the player to finish shutting down before switching the unit off.
EVOSABRE.SECTION_JOURNAL_DOC: What the display's program writes to the system journal. Read it with: journalctl -u evosabre-panel -f
EVOSABRE.LOG_LEVEL_DOC: Leave this on Errors only for everyday use. Changes adds each change of the player's state, each key and each change of brightness; Everything adds every repeat of a held key and every request made of the player.
EVOSABRE.RESTART_MSG: The display and the remote receiver are switched on in the boot configuration, which the player reads when it starts. Restart the player to bring them up.
